sentences.text:
Shriram General Insurance Co. Ltd. vs . Urmila Devi And on 16
June, 2023

Author: Vivek Singh Thakur
Bench: Vivek Singh Thakur
Shriram General Insurance Co. Ltd. Vs. Urmila Devi and others.
Present: Mr.Virender Sharma, Advocate, for the appellant.

Mr.Sanjay Bhardwaj and Mr.Raj Kumar Negi, Advocate, for respondents No. 1 to 4.
Neon for respondent No. 5.
rFAO No. 193 of 2022 Admit.
No post admission notices are required to be issued.
List for hearing in due course.
Present application has been filed for release of compensation amount in favour of respondents/applicants No. 1 and 4.

Taking into consideration the averments made in the application and reply thereto, at this stage,
25% of the awarded amount falling in shares of applicants/respondents No. 1 and 4 is directed to be released in their favour alongwith up to date interest by remitting the same in their bank accounts mentioned in para 5 of the application, photocopies whereof have also been placed on record.

The aforesaid release shall be subject to final outcome of the appeal and in case appeal is allowed and/or it is found that excess amount has been released to the applicants/respondents, they shall be liable to refund the same .
alongwith interest.

16th June, 2023 (Keshav)
Shriram General Insurance Co. Ltd. vs .
